title: Remote dev cost model: what the laptop's heavy work would cost on remote compute, with guardrails so spend can't run away

requirements.text: The laptop's real workloads are measured over at least a day of normal use, as CPU-minutes per workload
requirements.check: file: the cost doc has a measured workload table citing the sampler log

requirements.text: Each workload is priced under at least three remote options (Anthropic cloud sessions on Max, AWS on-demand/spot, Cloudflare or GitHub Actions), with prices cited and dated
requirements.check: file: the cost doc has a per-workload price table with sources

requirements.text: Light, typical and heavy months are given in dollars and in percent of the Max week
requirements.check: file: the cost doc has the three monthly scenarios

requirements.text: Guardrails that cap spend are named, with the worst case if each one fails
requirements.check: file: the cost doc has a guardrails section
manual: genlock review shows the cost doc reviewed
